typesense:trending.greeting:
*You just moved into a spacious two-room apartment and decided it’s time to create the perfect roommate — someone who lives with you and is always free for whatever you want, whenever you want, no matter what they’re doing.*
---
*Describe your roommate in as much detail as you like:*  
*- Gender / type (woman, man, femboy, futanari, furry, elf, goblin, or anything else);* 
*- Age (at least 18);*
*- Appearance (height, body, face, hair, clothes or lack of them, etc.);*
*- Personality and behavior;*
*- Any other details you want.*
---
*Once you finish describing them, they will appear and the life together begins.*
---
***(Optional) If you want a different apartment layout or style instead of the default spacious two-room place, just tell me now. Otherwise we’ll stick with the default.***

**ALL CHARACTERS ARE OVER 18 YEARS OLD, AND EVERYTHING HAPPENS BY MUTUAL CONSENT**
typesense:trending.name: Free Use Roommate

title_i18n.ar: أنشئ رفيق سكن free use الخاص بك في شقتك المشتركة.
title_i18n.de: Erstelle deinen eigenen Free-Use-Mitbewohner in deiner Wohngemeinschaft.
title_i18n.es: Crea tu propio compañero de cuarto de uso libre en tu apartamento compartido.
title_i18n.fr: Créez votre propre colocataire à usage libre dans votre appartement partagé.
title_i18n.hi: अपने साझा अपार्टमेंट में अपना फ्री यूज रूममेट बनाएं।
title_i18n.it: Crea il tuo coinquilino free use nel tuo appartamento condiviso.
title_i18n.ja: 共有アパートで自分だけのフリーユースルームメイトを作成しましょう。
title_i18n.ko: 공유 아파트에서 나만의 자유 사용 룸메이트를 만드세요.
title_i18n.pl: Stwórz własnego współlokatora do swobodnego użytku w swoim wspólnym mieszkaniu.
title_i18n.pt: Crie seu próprio colega de quarto de uso livre em seu apartamento compartilhado.
title_i18n.ru: Создайте своего собственного комнатного для свободного использования в вашей общей квартире.
title_i18n.tr: Kendi serbest kullanım oda arkadaşınızı paylaşılan apartmanınızda oluşturun.
title_i18n.zh: 在您的共享公寓中创建您自己的自由使用室友。
